content.title: 2026 World Baseball Classic: USA hold off Dominican Republic to march into third consecutive final
content.text: Albert Pujols: "It wasn't meant to be" In a game as tight as advertised, the Dominican Republic opened the scoring in the bottom of the second inning when Junior Caminero hit his third home run of the tournament off Skenes, who otherwise did not give up a run in 4-1/3 innings. Caminero’s homer was the 15th of this Classic by the Dominicans, setting a WBC team record. The United States countered with a pair of solo shots in the fourth, first by Gunnar Henderson and then Roman Anthony. They would be the last runs to be scored for the game, with the bullpen from both teams in lockdown mode. “We knew it was going to be a dogfight the whole game,” Henderson said. “It was really cool, just the way our game came together and battle through those tough innings and just hold that one-run ball game.” Closer Mason Miller struck out Geraldo Perdomo on a controversial call to end the game. Skenes fanned two and allowed six hits before passing the baton to Tyler Rogers. Skenes’s opposite number, Luis Severino, was equally solid in 3-1/3 innings, striking out six. While the two teams boasted a plethora of big bats in their lineup, opportunities were at a premium on this night, with very little margin of error allowed. Despite the few runs, the game didn’t disappoint and lived up to its billing. Dominican skipper Albert Pujols tipped his hat to the U.S., graciously saying it just “wasn’t meant to be.” “Obviously it didn’t go our way,” Pujols said. “Disappointing about the way the game ended. It wasn’t meant to be for us. Both teams pitched well. Our bullpen did an outstanding job. “I think the whole world saw two of the best teams with some of the best players in the game. That’s what’s so good about this tournament.” DeRosa appropriately summed up the night. “I go back to last time when (Shohei Ohtani) struck out Mike Trout. Baseball won that night. Whether we won or didn’t win, baseball won. I think baseball won again tonight."
